content.text: All preferred elements are present in §§ 18.1–18.2, so this is compliant with no redline needed.

input.quote:
18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 18 already sits at our preferred insurance position: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (unconditional, so it covers Vendor's processing of Customer Data), and workers' compensation as required by law, all maintained throughout the term and one year afterward. Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request, plus insurer quality, cancellation notice and non-limitation of liability terms that are favourable to us. Every preferred element is met, so no redline is warranted.
